subject: Ariba catalog sync: credential gating & MSA redline path
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <procurement@healthplus.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Ariba catalog sync + credential requirements

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward with Ariba catalog sync for our supplier set, but procurement IT and legal have a few gating items we need aligned before we can finish vendor provisioning: 

- Credentialing: vendor-side SFTP creds vs. Ariba-hosted dropbox — we need to know what Redwood supports and whether we can use HealthPlus-managed keys.
- PO requirement: our PO lines require GL code and department tax code in custom PO fields (GL_CODE, TAX_CLASS). Need to confirm the order form and EDI mapping will carry those.
- Legal: our contracts team will redline the MSA + order form for a couple of indemnity/insurance lines. Can Redwood accept a redline and track an electronic signature flow?

Can you confirm next steps and a rough timeline for getting the credential exchange and MSA review started? If useful, I can loop our vendor admin (vendor.admin@healthplus.com).

Cheers,
Marta Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager | HealthPlus
procurement@healthplus.com

Attachment: none (will send legal redlines separately)

1) Marissa will take the redline and produce a tracked MSA + order form response (we can accept redlines and run DocuSign once agreed).
2) Vivek will confirm whether HealthPlus-managed keys are compatible with our SFTP/Ariba flow and provide the PO-field mapping template.
3) We should kick off a 30-min tech sync to exchange creds and confirm the sample PO mapping.

Marissa / Vivek: can you confirm availability to review the legal redline and then a tech sync this week? Marta — if you can share the redlines as a PDF and the vendor admin contact, we'll get going.

Subject: Re: Ariba catalog sync + credential requirements — redline + onboarding checklist

Hi team,

Thanks — I reviewed HealthPlus' initial asks with legal. I've attached a redlined MSA (high level: limited indemnity adjustment, standard insurance thresholds, checkbox for data residency) and a clean order form template with the PO custom fields we typically surface to Ariba. Quick notes: 

- Legal turnaround: we can accept the redline and provide a counter-redline by EOD tomorrow if there are no novel clauses. To keep things moving, please flag any deal-level exceptions.
- DocuSign: we use our standard envelope; once countersigned we can route the fully executed docs to your procurement mailbox automatically.
- Order form fields: GL_CODE and TAX_CLASS are supported — Vivek, see the sample mapping I attached. We recommend using vendorAccountNumber as the canonical supplier ID to avoid duplicate catalog entries.

Operational onboarding checklist (recommended):
- HealthPlus supplies vendor.admin contact + preferred credential flow (SFTP key / Ariba dropbox).
- Redwood provides SFTP key pair or Ariba endpoint (depends on chosen flow).
- Sample PO/EDI file uploaded to a shared Drive for mapping verification.
- Pilot: enable catalog sync for 5 vendors for 48h, validate PO roundtrip, then full enablement.

Proposed times for a 30-min tech + legal sync: 2027-12-06 10:00-10:30 PT or 2027-12-06 14:00-14:30 PT. Marta — which works?

Attachments: [Redlined_MSA_KP_20271205.pdf, OrderForm_Template_KP_20271205.xlsx, PO_Field_Mapping_Sample.csv]

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Onboarding & Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — quick operational updates post-review and pre-call (quoting Marissa's checklist):

> - HealthPlus supplies vendor.admin contact + preferred credential flow (SFTP key / Ariba dropbox).
> - Redwood provides SFTP key pair or Ariba endpoint (depends on chosen flow).

1) Credentials: we can accept HealthPlus public keys for SFTP; send the OpenSSH public key to integrations@redwood.com (or have Miguel upload to the Drive link below). If you prefer Ariba-managed endpoints we will provide the endpoint URL and an integration token.

2) PO field mapping: attached CSV contains the mapping we will push through Ariba. Important: map GL_CODE to header element ext:GL_CODE and TAX_CLASS to ext:TAX_CLASS — Redwood will pass these through to the orderform and to downstream billing systems. Use vendorAccountNumber as canonical supplier id.

3) Pilot timeline: we can start credential exchange today, perform catalog push on 2027-12-08, monitor PO roundtrip for 48 hours, and schedule full activation for 2028-01-10 pending pilot success. If legal needs a minor clause change after our counter, DocuSign can be paused; target executed docs before pilot.

Links: Drive sample upload: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/healthplus-ariba-onboarding-4821
Jira ticket: PROC-1184 (tracking pilot activation)
DocuSign envelope preview: https://app.docusign.com/some/unique-id-4821

I'll join the 2027-12-06 14:00 PT sync (calendar invite sent). Looking forward to closing this out.
